posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
According to the help document, you have set the anchor point to the top left corner, additionally you have set the blending mode to an invalid blend mode.
As the help documentation states, map notes are:
LAYER_S ID GRAPHIC X Y OPACITY Z BLEND XANCHOR YANCHOR CHAR ROTATE
Yours are:
LAYER_S 1(ID) Dungeon1Bottom(Graphic) 0(x) 0(y) 255(opacity) 0.5(z) 10(blend) 0(xanchor) 0(yanchor)
Please ensure that you check the help documentation thoroughly.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Okay, so to be fair, this one isn't entirely on you since the documentation leaves something to be desired.
char and rot are optional.
If you use X/Y values (which are pixel values, not tiles) then you should not use a char value - leave it blank (same thing for rot).
Something like this:
Code:
LAYER_S 1 Dungeon1Bottom 640 480 255 0.5 0 0.5 0.5
fwiw, I've always bound the image to an autorun event and rarely use the map notetag.
